title: Delta Packet
description: Minimal non-redundant training record. Captures the difference between failed behavior and desired behavior, anchored to a context_root. Per slm-learning-186/192. Storage shrinks; signal density grows.

root_context_id.description: ID of the context_root this packet attaches to. Composes with root.shared_instruction at load time.

base_model.description: HF id of the base model (e.g. Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct)

failure_type.description: Specific failure label (edge_case_miss / wrong_signature / hallucination / etc.)

base_output_ref.description: Content hash of the base's failed output. Used for dedup + audit. Format: 'sha256:...' or path to a corpus entry.

minimal_prompt.description: The shortest prompt that, combined with root.shared_instruction, reproduces the failure.

correction.description: Canonical / desired output. The training target.

tests.description: Optional tests that the correction must pass. Used by judge for code-execution scoring.

retain_tags.description: Tags identifying which retain-bank groups this packet wants paired during consolidation.

target_contract.description: Output contract the correction satisfies (function_definition / tool_action_json / etc.)

token_budget.description: Soft budget for combined root+packet length at training time. Composer warns if exceeded.
